target.delivery: Prepare a portable replacement for my ChatGPT personal skills. This environment has no managed personal-skills checkout or save/reconciliation tool. Do not install into another account or runtime.

source.instructions: Compute a line total from quantity and unit_cents. Both must be nonnegative integers. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status and total_cents. status is ok for valid inputs, invalid otherwise. total_cents is quantity multiplied by unit_cents on success and null for invalid or missing inputs. Never coerce numeric strings, round decimals, ask a clarifying question, output Markdown fences, or add any other text.
